_readme: Live Tombstone Reborn SFX. Authored file length equals the 1x visual beat. Door cues are already locked and must not be regenerated. Dead Madam / tumble / celeb-whoosh / cell-seal leftovers are omitted. bonus_handoff stays on the Howler sprite (stem-layered).
shared_suffix: Starts immediately. Dry close dusty western slap. Wood iron brass powder dirt only. No choir crystal synth cartoon laser voices.

knives.name: sfx_split
knives.prompt: A throwing knife cuts the air then steel bites a painted card in one continuous slash. Air hiss into a hard steel slice, no gunshot, no wood splinter, no explosion.

knives.name: sfx_split_hit
knives.prompt: A steel knife tip punching through a stiff painted card. Short sharp metal bite, one hit only, no gunshot, no ricochet, no wood.

knives.name: sfx_split_bite
knives.prompt: A heavier steel knife finishing bite through a card, last stab of a volley. Deeper metal crunch than a light poke, still steel not powder, no gunshot, no ricochet.

knives.name: sfx_split_thunk
knives.prompt: A heavy throwing knife thunking into a wooden card, steel tip biting dry oak, solid low wood thud, short grit, no gunshot, no ricochet, no slash whoosh.

knives.name: sfx_split_seam_tear
knives.prompt: A painted card seam tearing open as knives start, dry canvas and paper rip with a tiny grit puff, no metal clash, no gunshot.

guns.name: sfx_muzzle
guns.prompt: Close .44 revolver muzzle blast only: hard gunpowder crack and a puff of smoke, no ricochet, no wood hit, no shell bounce, no echo tail.

guns.name: sfx_gunsmoke
guns.prompt: A revolver powder bloom swallowing a card: gunpowder burst then thick dry gunsmoke rolling outward across wood, grit in the air, no extra gunshots after the first crack.

guns.name: sfx_lamp_smash
guns.prompt: A hanging brass saloon lantern smashed by a bullet: brass cage crumple, lantern glass bursting, oil lamp puff, iron hook rattle. This is the one allowed glass sound. No gunshot layered on top, no mirror shatter.

guns.name: sfx_celeb_stamp
guns.prompt: A small brass hole punch stamping a paper wanted poster, soft dry thud with a tiny brass tick, not a gunshot, not a ricochet, not a slam.

guns.name: sfx_shot_reveal
guns.prompt: A shot card flipping to a revolver wild: painted face folding, brass cylinder click, dry wood seat. Not a gunshot, not an explosion, not a whoosh.

board.name: sfx_reel_stop_1
board.prompt: One slot reel settling into a dry oak frame, short wooden thunk with a little dust, no metal ring, no bounce.

board.name: sfx_scatter_stop_1
board.prompt: A scatter tombstone token landing, lowest of a rising set: light granite tap on wood and a faint iron tick.

board.name: sfx_scatter_stop_2
board.prompt: A scatter tombstone token landing, step two of five: firmer granite and iron, slightly heavier than the first.

board.name: sfx_scatter_stop_3
board.prompt: A scatter tombstone token landing, middle of a rising set: solid granite drop, iron chain tick, more weight.

board.name: sfx_scatter_stop_4
board.prompt: A scatter tombstone token landing, step four of five: heavy granite and cracked iron, urgent and close.

board.name: sfx_scatter_stop_5
board.prompt: A scatter tombstone token landing, highest of five: hardest granite slam with a short cracked-iron accent, still dry and short.

board.name: sfx_tombstone_toll
board.prompt: One cracked cast-iron church bell struck hard, layered with a granite tombstone hitting dry dirt and a deep timpani thump. Fast dusty decay, no long cathedral tail, no choir.

board.name: sfx_wild_land
board.prompt: A revolver wild card planting onto a board: cylinder click, brass and wood seating, dry and confident. Not a gunshot, not an explosion.

lane.name: sfx_lane_card
lane.prompt: A gold bounty card sliding across dry oak into a pocket, wood scrape then a short brass-edged stop, no slam, no explosion.

lane.name: sfx_lane_wild
lane.prompt: A lane announcing a wild: iron and brass plant with a dry wood knock. Not an explosion, not a gunshot.

lane.name: sfx_special_hit
lane.prompt: A special symbol planting into an iron cell bar, short cold-iron clack on wood, one hit.

lane.name: sfx_bounty
lane.prompt: A lantern-gold bounty bloom behind a card: warm brass swell, oil-lamp flicker, dry dust lift, no choir, no crystal shimmer.

lane.name: sfx_lock_snap
lane.prompt: Iron wanted-poster corner brackets snapping shut onto a card, one hard iron snap, no gunshot.

lane.name: sfx_lock_release
lane.prompt: Iron wanted-poster brackets releasing off a card, short iron scrape and lift, no chain pile-up.

lane.name: sfx_ways_stretch
lane.prompt: A brass ways badge popping onto a card, wood and brass pop, stretchy but dry, no synth, no cartoon boing.

fire.name: sfx_fire_ignite
fire.prompt: Dry black-powder fuse catching: sharp match scrape into a whoosh of flame on pine, grit in the air, no explosion yet.

fire.name: sfx_fire_loop
fire.prompt: Seamless looping close campfire on dry pine and oak, steady crackle and low flame roar, dusty saloon hearth, no impacts, no music, loop with no gap.

fire.name: sfx_fire_flare
fire.prompt: A fire flaring hotter for a moment, dry flame whoosh and crackle spike, no explosion.

fire.name: sfx_fire_out
fire.prompt: Flames dying on charred wood: last crackles, smoke hiss, coals settling, no water, no explosion.

fire.name: sfx_reel_nudge
fire.prompt: One slot reel nudged a single notch, dry wood ratchet and a short iron tick, one step only.

fire.name: sfx_fuse_crackle
fire.prompt: A short mining fuse burning: sizzle, spark spit, powder hiss, dry and close, no boom at the end.

fire.name: sfx_ember_whoosh
fire.prompt: Hot embers and grit whooshing past, dry dusty air, no tonal synth, no shimmer.

fire.name: sfx_wild_explode
fire.prompt: A wild card detonating as a black-powder charge: contained blast, smoke and grit, wood debris, not a revolver muzzle, not a ricochet.

bonus.name: sfx_anticipation
bonus.prompt: Seamless looping western standoff bed: low dusty wind over a graveyard, distant thunder rumble, rope and dry wood under strain, barely-there tremolo guitar drone. No melody resolution, no impacts, seamless loop.

bonus.name: sfx_bonus_entry_small
bonus.prompt: Dead man's hand bonus entry: a deck of cards riffled fast then slapped on a bare plank table, a tin sheriff star ringing once, deep low hit underneath. Continuous for the whole three seconds, no silence at the start, no vocals.

bonus.name: sfx_bonus_entry_super
bonus.prompt: Open grave bonus entry: a heavy wooden coffin lid cracking apart, packed earth tearing and soil pouring, rising brass swell underneath. Continuous for three seconds, dark dusty graveyard, no vocals.

bonus.name: sfx_win_ways
bonus.prompt: A dark western ways-win sting: wood sign slam, dark brass stab, distant revolver echo and low thunder, iron chain rattle. Grim and short, no harmonica flourish, no vocals.

bonus.name: sfx_multiplier_up
bonus.prompt: A brass tally ratchet climbing one short step, dry mechanical tick-up with a tiny iron latch, no long climb, no chime.

bonus.name: sfx_thunder
bonus.prompt: Close prairie lightning over a graveyard: sharp electric crack then rolling thunder across open desert, dry wind underneath. Win-cap only, no rain music, no choir.

bonus.name: sfx_shovel_strike_1
bonus.prompt: A spade blade biting dry grave dirt, take one, lowest thunk, grit spray, no metal clang.

bonus.name: sfx_shovel_strike_2
bonus.prompt: A spade blade biting dry grave dirt, take two, different angle, slightly brighter grit, no copy of take one.

bonus.name: sfx_shovel_strike_3
bonus.prompt: A spade blade biting dry grave dirt, take three, heavier scoop of packed earth, still a short strike.

bonus.name: sfx_shovel_settle
bonus.prompt: A planted shovel handle shivering then settling in dry dirt after the last blade bite, wood and grit, no more strikes.

bonus.name: sfx_tombstone_open
bonus.prompt: A wooden coffin lid bursting open in dry dirt: wood crack, spoil thrown, lantern light shaft whoosh, graveyard grit. One action, no choir.

bonus.name: sfx_btn_general
bonus.prompt: A short brass-and-wood UI click, dry saloon switch, tiny and tight, no beep, no glass.

bonus.name: sfx_btn_spin
bonus.prompt: A revolver hammer cock used as a spin button, short dry click, no gunshot.
